evidence: Introduces OPES-expand, adapting the OPES iterative scheme to sample expanded ensemble target distributions
Introduces the concept of expansion CVs delta_u_lambda that characterize expanded ensemble targets and define the OPES bias
Provides the unified target distribution perspective: both CV-based and tempering families can be understood as targeting specific probability distributions, with expanded ensembles as the key bridge
Demonstrates OPES-expand sampling multicanonical, multithermal-multibaric, thermodynamic integration, multiumbrella, and combined phase diagram ensembles without fixed replica count
Shows by focusing on target distributions that CV-based and tempering methods are unified; OPES can sample targets of both families
OPES-expand variant specifically designed to sample expanded ensemble target distributions
Expansion CVs are the formal characterization of expanded ensemble targets; define both the bias and the free energy differences to estimate
